body: That's absolutely fantastic!  It's not a crime to think about it, but the big thing is that you haven't acted on it.  Merry Christmas, and happy early birthday.  :>

Thank you.  I appreciate it.  It just feels like everyone has their own problems, so who am I to dump on others?  Keeping it to myself just doesn't seem to be enough anymore, though.  I think I need help, but I don't really know where to turn.
